Internal helper: the stop for a data frame's name typed wrong (ruling R36)

Source: R/checks.R
dot-jst_misspelled_frame_stop.Rd

"'dd' not found." / "If you meant the data frame d:" and the call as typed with the data frame in place of the name. When that call would still stop for want of an input – jrecode(dd, Age) with no map – ruling R23's stop is given instead, its lead "'dd' not found, and no map was named." (.jst_gap_stop()), so no line offered stops again.

Usage

.jst_misspelled_frame_stop(fn, typed_name, fr, offered, envir, cl = NULL)

Arguments

fn

Character(1). The user-facing function's name.

typed_name

Character(1). The name typed.

fr

Character(1). The data frame meant (.jst_misspelled_frame()).

offered

The call to offer.

envir

The caller's environment.

cl

The call as typed, for ruling R23's example; NULL for none.

Value

Does not return; stops.
